failure_reason: Akamai Bot Manager blocks category/PLP pages on qvc.com with an HTTP 418 challenge response (direct HTTP/curl_cffi with Chrome TLS impersonation) and with a blank, non-resolving 'Powered and protected by Akamai' challenge screen (Playwright/CDP, headless and headed, and Claude-in-Chrome real browser session). The Claude-in-Chrome session was blocked even on the site root (https://www.qvc.com/), not just category paths, confirming a full site-wide bot-manager wall rather than a single-URL issue. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic 'Allow: /'), so this is an access failure, not a policy opt-out. No archived/cached copy was substituted per the hard ban on Wayback/proxy fallbacks.
notes: robots.txt (https://www.qvc.com/robots.txt) checked first: general User-agent rules are 'Allow: /' with only account/checkout/search paths disallowed; no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry present. Access attempts, in tier order: (1) curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 direct HTTP -> site root https://www.qvc.com/ returned 200 (415KB, real homepage HTML) and yielded real category URLs from the nav (e.g. /c/for-the-home/holiday/-/rony/c.html, /c/for-the-home/holiday/christmas/-/1y56w1h/c.html, /c/for-the-home/halloween/-/lglu-1z139y3/c.html, plus /collections/holiday-halloween.html and /collections/holiday-labor-day.html), but every one of those category-page fetches (including the assignment's own N-17h8 Home & Garden URL) returned HTTP 418 with an AkamaiGHost 'QVC.com is currently unavailable' block page, even when reusing the session cookies from the successful root fetch and adding a Referer header. (2) Playwright/CDP (headless and headed Chromium, navigator.webdriver masked, real Chrome UA) -> both the root page and the category page returned the same Akamai block page (headless) or the 'QVC.com is currently unavailable' page (headed). (3) Claude-in-Chrome (own new tab, real user Chrome session) -> both the category URL and the site root loaded an Akamai 'Powered and protected by' challenge screen that stayed blank/unresolved after repeated waits (up to ~20s total) with no interactive content ever appearing in the accessibility tree besides a single unlabeled button, which was not clicked (CAPTCHA/bot-challenge interaction is off-limits). No seasonal categories could be discovered or verified because no tier could render any qvc.com category, search, or sitemap page. Recommend a manual review / different network path for this company. RETRY 2026-09-04: re-checked robots.txt (User-agent entries present: *, Googlebot, Googlebot-image, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot -- no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry, so not a policy opt-out). Tried the full alternate-network-path toolkit before falling back to browser tiers: (1) curl_cffi impersonation brute force across 22 profile/session combinations (chrome99/100/101/110/116/120/124/131, edge99/101, firefox133/135, safari15_3/15_5/17_0/18_0, safari18_0_ios, safari184_ios -- both one-off and warmed-up Session() runs with homepage-first cookie/referer chains and realistic delays) against the assignment URL and /c/for-the-home/holiday/christmas/-/1y56w1h/c.html: desktop Chrome/Firefox/Edge/older-Safari profiles all returned a hard HTTP 418 AkamaiGHost block (~1.3KB); the two iOS Safari profiles (safari18_0_ios, safari184_ios) uniquely got a 200 but it was Akamai's JS sensor/behavioral challenge page (script posts sensor_data then reloads) -- unsolvable without a real JS engine, never real content, and warming the session up via homepage->parent-category->target with matching referers made no difference (still 418 on every category URL). (2) r.jina.ai reader proxy on the assignment URL: blocked before even reaching qvc.com -- r.jina.ai itself served a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' managed challenge (403). (3) translate.goog (www-qvc-com.translate.goog, _x_tr_tl=es) on the assignment URL: proxied through to the real origin but faithfully reflected QVC's own HTTP 418 block status, same result as direct access. (4) Googlebot UA string on curl_cffi against the assignment URL: still 418, no different treatment. (5) Sitemaps: DID succeed where every page-render route failed -- https://www.qvc.com/sitemap-us-index.xml, sitemap-us-navigation-for-the-home.xml, and sitemap-us-navigation-garden-and-outdoor-living.xml all returned real 200 XML (no /sitemap.xml at that exact path, 404, but the robots.txt-listed one works). This revealed the real category taxonomy: under For The Home there is a 'Holiday' branch (https://www.qvc.com/c/for-the-home/holiday/-/rony/c.html) with children Seasonal Decorations (.../holiday/seasonal-decorations/-/1w3tvc5/c.html), Christmas (.../holiday/christmas/-/1y56w1h/c.html), Gift Wrap and Party Supplies (.../holiday/gift-wrap-and-party-supplies/-/iubxnv/c.html), and Costumes (.../holiday/costumes/-/p32u41/c.html) which itself has Masks and Kids Costumes children; no holiday/seasonal branch exists under Garden and Outdoor Living. This is a genuine lead (same 'N-'/category-ID URL family as confirmed-real PLPs elsewhere on the site) but NOT used to record rows: no tier ever rendered the actual page content for any of these URLs, so none could be confirmed as a genuine product-listing page (vs. a marketing/landing page), none yielded an exact qty+evidence, and 'Costumes' vs. an explicit Halloween association could not be content-verified either -- recording rows on URL/taxonomy inference alone would violate the qty/evidence and PLP-verification rules. (6) api.qvc.com's own typeahead search API (referenced in the homepage's embedded qVars/Constructor.io config) is reachable and returns real JSON/XML API errors rather than a block page, confirming that specific subdomain/path isn't behind the same WAF rule -- but it is a typeahead endpoint, not a category-browse API, its required request shape/auth could not be reverse-engineered from static HTML alone, and it would not have been a category-taxonomy or qty source regardless. (7) Fell back to the browser tiers last: a fresh Playwright headless Chromium attempt (navigator.webdriver masked, realistic desktop UA/viewport, 8s settle wait) against the Christmas category URL hit the same Akamai edge block (rendered 'Error ID' / 'Connecting Address' Akamai reference page), confirming the block operates at the WAF/edge layer regardless of browser automation stealth. Claude-in-Chrome was attempted 4 times (plain tabs_context_mcp, explicit-tabId navigate, browser_batch) but the extension's MCP tab-group session could not be established in this environment this run ("No tab available" / tab group invalidated between calls before any page load completed) -- inconclusive for this retry due to an environment/connection issue, not a fresh confirmation of the Akamai wall from that specific tier. Net result: every content-rendering path (18+ curl_cffi profiles, warmed sessions, r.jina.ai, translate.goog, Googlebot UA, fresh Playwright) independently hit the same Akamai Bot Manager wall on every /c/.../c.html category page; only sitemap XML and the site root are reachable. Status remains blocked; no rows recorded.
